name: MergerFin
description: Federates remote Jellyfin servers into your local Jellyfin libraries with native multi-version deduplication, per-user upstream account mapping, and watch-state sync.
overview: Unify multiple remote Jellyfin servers directly inside your existing Jellyfin server.

versions.changelog: Fix playback on third-party Jellyfin clients (OptiFin, Wholphin, Jellyfin Android TV, Infuse, Swiftfin, Findroid): restore SupportsDirectPlay=true when undoing ForceRemoteSourceTranscoding Static=true overrides (instead of leaving SupportsDirectPlay=false with TranscodingUrl=null), sanitize client-facing DTOs to Protocol=File / IsRemote=false / virtual Path so clients never filter out HTTP/remote sources or connect to loopback 127.0.0.1, strip forced allowVideoStreamCopy=false / allowAudioStreamCopy=false on HLS remuxes, backfill real metadata/MediaStreams on BaseItemDto (skipped for MergerFin mesh sync callers), and copy full MediaStream codec/HDR metadata on multi-version mf_* sources.
Add inline Priority, Stream Mode, and Enabled editing + full server Edit button (preserving existing API Key when left blank) in the plugin configuration page.

Fix live progress timecode updates on remote servers running the PlaybackReporting plugin: PlaybackReporting crashes with HTTP 400 ArgumentOutOfRangeException (e.Users[0]) on /Sessions/Playing/Progress for API-key sessions, so MergerFin now automatically falls back to /Sessions/Playing (HTTP 204, updates PositionTicks + WebSocket every 5s and immediately on seek/pause).

Fix timeline seek doubling bug on .strm HTTP sources: add PlaybackInfoFixFilter to convert Static=true TranscodingUrl responses into proper SupportsDirectStream=true responses (eliminating 2x transcodingOffsetTicks jumps in jellyfin-web), populate real remote Size & Bitrate instead of 75-byte .strm stub size, and silence normal client-disconnect warnings during Byte-Range seeks.
Relay timeline seeks (>15s jumps) immediately to remote dashboards without waiting for the 10s progress interval, and set CanSeek=true on relayed playstate.

Hook PlaybackProgress (live timecode & pause updates every 10s on remote dashboard), track active remote playback sessions by local SessionId so PlaybackStopped always closes the exact remote session card, and add a 90s stale-session reaper so cards never stay stuck.

Backfill missing RunTimeTicks on remote .strm items during sync (fixes Continue Watching progress bars and 90% auto-complete), and sync resume PlaybackPositionTicks + explicit Played=true/position=0 reset to matched remote users via POST /UserItems/{id}/UserData.

Mesh anti-loop catalog sync: ignore remote MergerFin .strm stubs, mf_* MediaSources, /MergerFin/Stream/* URLs, and remote HTTP streams so two or more Jellyfin servers syncing each other only exchange their real local files.

Fix infinite playback echo loop between meshed MergerFin servers (ignore API-key / User-null / mf-* sessions), only report live playback to the single remote server actually streaming the file, include PlaySessionId, and add 15s deduplication cooldown on UserData sync.

Full API Key mode: removed username/password auth and manual per-user account linking. Remote servers connect with a single Jellyfin API Key and watch-state sync automatically matches remote users by username via GET /Users.
Pass CollapseBoxSetItems=false when syncing remote Jellyfin servers so movies grouped in Collections/Sagas are indexed, and add SkipLocalDuplicatesInStrm toggle for standalone remote libraries.
Fix false 'Authentication failed' error caused by Jellyfin's PascalCase JSON serializer mismatching camelCase properties in configPage.html.
Fix configPage.html layout (proper Jellyfin .inputContainer/.selectContainer alignment) and replace ES6 template literals so Jellyfin globalize.translateHtml no longer mangles dropdown labels.

Initial release for Jellyfin 12.4: native IMediaSourceProvider multi-version injection, optional remote-only .strm sync, per-user upstream account mapping, real session identity forwarding, and watch-state sync.
